title: Lesson 29. The score
description: The "Score" variable: count apples and add a win

questions.prompt: Match the block with what it does
You make a variable in the orange "Variables" blocks.
What does the enemy do in the ⭐⭐ task?
options: Touching it resets the score to 0

questions.prompt: A score counter appears on the stage after making the variable.
questions.explain: You can see how many apples you got.

questions.prompt: What is the variable called in our game?

learn.intro: A game needs a score! Today we teach the computer to remember a number — and the game will know when you win.

slides.text: A **variable** is a little box labelled "Score" with a number inside. You can put a new number in or add to it.
Orange "Variables" blocks → **"Make a variable"** → name it "Score" → OK. A counter appears on the stage.

options: A box where the computer remembers a number

slides.text: At the start the box is empty: **"set Score to 0"**. Inside "if touching the hero" — **"change Score by 1"**.
slides.code:
when green flag clicked
set "Score" to 0
...
    if touching "My hero" then
        change "Score" by 1

check.prompt: At the start of the game the score should be set to 0.
check.explain: Otherwise the last game's score stays.

slides.text: Victory for the hero: wait until the score is 10, then say "Victory!".
slides.code:
when green flag clicked
wait until "Score" = 10
say "Victory!" for 2 seconds

slides.text: Star tasks: ⭐ the apple appears faster with each point; ⭐⭐ add an enemy — touching it resets the score to 0.
